authority_boundary: Reviewed compact rules compiled into DAD preflight context packs. Local repo source authority still governs adoption.

non_negotiables.rule: Local repo source authority beats DAD recommendations; conflicts stop for human review.
Mail, offerings, harnesses, and generated reports are candidate evidence until reviewed locally.
Never place secrets, private rows, credentials, or long raw source blobs in DAD mail or cross-repo payloads.
Normal DAD recurring operation writes only .digital-asset/mail/**; broader writes require enrollment approval.
Close material work with postflight and trace any used, ignored, failed, or harmful DAD recommendation.
